description: A comprehensive REST API for Arabic poetry, providing access to thousands of poems, poets, and advanced statistics.

poems.description: The beating heart of the system. These endpoints allow browsing poems with filtering, and retrieving the full text of any poem.

endpoints.description: List poems (verses excluded to reduce payload size) with filtering and pagination support.
Get a single poem with all verses, plus poet name, era, meter, and topics.

poets.description: Endpoints for searching poets and retrieving their details and statistics (e.g., poem count and most-used meters).

endpoints.description: List poets with their total poem count, with optional search by name.
Get a single poet's details plus quick stats (total poems and top 3 meters used).
List all poems by a specific poet (with the meter name for each poem).

reference.description: Reference endpoints that return core lookup lists. Typically used to populate dropdowns in frontend applications.

endpoints.description: Get the list of all available poetry topics.
Get the list of all available poetic meters.
Get the list of all available historical eras.

statistics.description: Advanced analytical endpoints that return pre-aggregated data, ready for chart rendering.

endpoints.description: Distribution of poems across historical eras.
Count of poems written in each poetic meter.
List of the most prolific poets in the database.

admin.description: Restricted admin endpoints. Require a security token in the request header. Used for custom queries not covered by other endpoints.

endpoints.description: Execute a raw SQL query (SELECT only). Requires an x-admin-token header.
examples: Body: {"sql": "SELECT name, era_id FROM poets LIMIT 5"}
